properties.name: Hopple Street
properties.note: on the line of the 1904 "Hopple (Bridge Av.)" from Meeker across Spring Grove, the deck's north lobe and Mill Creek to Beekman Street, at deck level since the north trunk became a viaduct (2026-10-14): Beekman 160.8 m, the deck about 158.9 m, Meeker 157.6 m. It passes 6.5 m under the trunk viaduct and TRI B/D's Camp Washington station, and RER A's viaduct crosses over it near Beekman (rail 168.2 m). Johnson's south end and Spring Grove meet it at grade

properties.name: Ludlow Avenue
properties.note: at ground on its 1914 line (Ben, 22 October): from Dodsworth Avenue (the 1904 name of its first block from Knowlton's Corner, 149.4 m) over Mill Creek and under the trunk, which rises on fill to a span over it (rail 162.5 m; Ludlow 155.4 m there), then about 2% up to the old canal bank (163-166 m). OH-75 / Millvale Boulevard meets it at a signal, at a skew of about 28 degrees
